free_tier_limits.correction: The associated api.data.gov service publishes a default limit of 1,000 requests per hour per API key, although individual services may override it.

rate_limits.correction: A default rate limit of 1,000 requests per hour is published; service-specific limits may vary.

notes: The official URDB documentation supports the endpoint, required API key, free signup, filters, and example request. OpenEI's signup uses api.data.gov, whose official manual publishes a default 1,000-request hourly limit, so the two limit claims are not accurate. CORS behavior is not documented and could not be independently established.
